scripts.build: rm -f prisma.config.ts prisma.config.js && rm -rf node_modules .prisma prisma/.prisma .next && npm ci --cache /tmp/npm-cache --prefer-offline --unsafe-perm --no-audit --no-fund && chmod -R a+rX node_modules/@prisma node_modules/prisma && find node_modules/@prisma node_modules/prisma -type f \( -name '*.so.node' -o -name '*.so' -o -name '*.exe' \) -exec chmod a+x {} + && node db-setup.js && NODE_ENV=production PRISMA_CLI_QUERY_ENGINE_TYPE=binary PRISMA_CLIENT_ENGINE_TYPE=binary node ./node_modules/prisma/build/index.js --version && NODE_ENV=production PRISMA_CLI_QUERY_ENGINE_TYPE=binary PRISMA_CLIENT_ENGINE_TYPE=binary node ./node_modules/prisma/build/index.js generate --schema=prisma/schema.prisma && NODE_ENV=production PRISMA_CLI_QUERY_ENGINE_TYPE=binary PRISMA_CLIENT_ENGINE_TYPE=binary node ./node_modules/prisma/build/index.js db push --accept-data-loss --schema=prisma/schema.prisma && NODE_ENV=production next build
scripts.postinstall: if [ "$NODE_ENV" = "production" ]; then npm run build; fi
scripts.prestart: rm -f src/middleware.ts src/proxy.ts && [ -d .next ] || npm run build
scripts.start: sh -c 'NODE_ENV=production PRISMA_CLIENT_ENGINE_TYPE=binary node runtime-init.js && NODE_ENV=production PRISMA_CLIENT_ENGINE_TYPE=binary node index.js'
